info.description: API for a small handmade toy shop
info.title: Kachenyatko Store API

get.description: Categories sorted by name, paginated with limit/offset. The response includes the total number of categories

post.description: Create a category by name; the slug is generated from the name

put.description: Rename a category by its ID; the slug is regenerated from the new name

delete.description: Delete a category by its ID. Fails if the category still has toys

get.description: Get a category by its slug
Reports that the process is running. Does not check dependencies

post.description: Check email and password and set an HttpOnly access_token cookie. Limited to 5 attempts per minute per client IP; exceeding it returns 429
Clear the access_token cookie. Works without a valid session, so it never returns 401

Set-Cookie.description: access_token=; Path=/; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Max-Age=0; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax

get.description: Get the logged-in user from the access_token cookie. Use it on page load to check whether the session is still valid
All orders, both for catalog toys and custom ones, sorted from newest to oldest, paginated with limit/offset

post.description: Order a toy that is not in the catalog. The message describing the toy is required. Limited to 10 orders per 10 minutes per client IP across both order endpoints; exceeding it returns 429

parameters.description: Contact details and description of the toy
parameters.name: order

get.description: Orders for toys that are not in the catalog, sorted from newest to oldest, paginated with limit/offset
Get an order by its ID, either for a catalog toy or a custom one

patch.description: Change the status of an order by its ID

get.description: Reports whether the service can handle requests: pings the database with a timeout (DB_PING_TIMEOUT)
Toys sorted from newest to oldest, paginated with limit/offset. The response includes the total number of toys

parameters.description: Filter by category slug, e.g. soft-toys
parameters.name: category

post.description: Create a toy. The category is matched by name and created automatically if it does not exist

get.description: Toys sorted by number of orders (most ordered first), then from newest to oldest. Toys without orders are included at the end. Paginated with limit/offset. The response includes the total number of toys

parameters.description: Filter by category slug, e.g. soft-toys
parameters.name: category

get.description: Get a toy by its ID

put.description: Replace all fields of a toy by its ID. The category is matched by name and created automatically if it does not exist

delete.description: Delete a toy by its ID together with all of its images

get.description: All images of a toy, sorted by position. Returns an empty array if the toy has no images or does not exist

post.description: Upload 1-5 images (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each) in the "images" field. New images are appended after existing ones. A toy can have at most 5 images in total; exceeding it returns 409

parameters.description: Image files (repeat the field to upload several)
parameters.name: images

get.description: Get an image of a toy by its ID

delete.description: Delete an image of a toy by its ID. The image file is also removed from storage

get.description: Orders for a catalog toy, sorted from newest to oldest, paginated with limit/offset

post.description: Place an order for a toy from the catalog. The message is optional. Limited to 10 orders per 10 minutes per client IP across both order endpoints; exceeding it returns 429

get.description: Users sorted from oldest to newest, paginated with limit/offset
Get a user by their ID

delete.description: Delete a user by their ID

patch.description: Change a user's email by their ID; the email must be unique (case-insensitive)

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier generated from the name

name.description: Category name; the slug is generated from it

total.description: Total number of categories, across all pages

details.description: Description of what the customer wants; required for custom orders without a toy
details.example: A grey rabbit, about 25cm tall with long ears

message.example: Would like it in blue, please

phone.description: Customer phone number in international format

details.example: Would like it in blue, please

message.example: Please contact me via Telegram rather than calling

toy_id.description: Ordered toy; null for custom orders

total.description: Total number of orders, across all pages

description.example: Soft plush bear, safe for children from 3 years

size.description: Free-form size, e.g. dimensions in centimeters

position.description: Zero-based order of the image within the toy; new images are appended to the end

url.description: Public URL of the image file

category_name.description: Category name; the category is created if it does not exist

description.example: Soft plush bear, safe for children from 3 years

size.description: Free-form size, e.g. dimensions in centimeters

total.description: Total number of toys, across all pages

email.description: New email; must be unique, case-insensitive
